$enable-rounded.description: Off squares every corner in the system, including components that set their own radius.

$enable-shadows.description: Off removes the depth cues from buttons and inputs. The elevation scale still exists for components that ask for it.

$enable-gradients.description: Adds a subtle sheen over filled components. Off gives flat fills.

$enable-caret.description: The little triangle on dropdown toggles.

$enable-transitions.description: Off removes every transition. Prefer `$enable-reduced-motion`, which respects the reader’s own setting.

$enable-reduced-motion.description: Honours `prefers-reduced-motion`. Leave this on: turning it off overrides an accessibility preference the reader set deliberately.

$enable-smooth-scroll.description: Smooth scrolling for in-page links. Off by default, and still gated on `prefers-reduced-motion` when on.

$enable-grid-classes.description: Generates `.row` and `.col-*`. Off if you lay out with CSS grid or your own system.

$enable-cssgrid.description: Generates the CSS-grid layout classes alongside the flex ones.

$enable-button-pointers.description: Gives buttons `cursor: pointer`. Off matches the native platform behaviour.

$enable-deprecation-messages.description: Warns at compile time when you use something scheduled for removal. Worth leaving on.

$color-mode-type.description: Whether dark mode follows the system setting or a `data-bs-theme` attribute you control.

$min-contrast-ratio.description: The ratio `color-contrast()` aims for when picking text to sit on a fill. 4.5 is WCAG AA for body text.

$color-contrast-dark.description: The dark option `color-contrast()` chooses between when deciding what to put on a fill.

$button-sizes.description: Which button size classes are generated. Dropping one removes `.btn-xs` and its CSS entirely.

$pagination-sizes.description: Which pagination size classes are generated.

$otp-sizes.description: Which one-time-code input size classes are generated.

$strength-levels.description: The names of the password strength meter’s levels, weakest first.

$avatar-sizes.value: ( "xs": ( size: 1.5rem, status-size: .625rem, ), "sm": ( size: 2rem, ), "lg": ( size: 3rem, status-size: 1rem, border-width: 3px, ), "xl": ( size: 4rem, status-size: 1.25rem, border-width: 4px, ), )
$avatar-sizes.description: Which avatar size classes are generated, and how big each one is.

$dialog-sizes.description: Which dialog size classes are generated, and the max-width of each.

$form-control-sizes.description: Which form control size classes are generated. Keep in step with `$otp-sizes`.

$input-group-sizes.description: Which input group size classes are generated.

$validation-states.description: Maps each validation state to the theme colour it borrows. Add a state here and its feedback classes are generated for you.

$table-striped-order.description: Which rows a striped table shades.

$table-striped-columns-order.description: Which columns a column-striped table shades.

$stretched-link-pseudo-element.description: Which pseudo-element `.stretched-link` uses, in case it collides with your own.
